# @native-html/render

> A WebView-free, pure-JavaScript React Native component that renders HTML into 100% native iOS and Android views. Powered by the Transient Render Engine (TRE): an HTML5-compliant pipeline that parses HTML, builds a Transient Render Tree (TRT) of `TNode`s, processes CSS into React Native styles (with inheritance, specificity, font selection, and whitespace collapsing), and renders the tree through composable internal and custom renderers. This is the monorepo (formerly `react-native-render-html`); core packages include `@native-html/render`, `@native-html/transient-render-engine`, and `@native-html/css-processor`.

This `llms.txt` is a navigation guide for the live documentation at https://native-html.github.io/render/. For a single consolidated file covering all topics, see [llms-full.txt](https://native-html.github.io/render/llms-full.txt).

When unsure where a topic lives:
- "What is this library / minimal example / FAQ" → Getting Started
- "How does an HTML string become native views / what is TRE / how does CSS resolve" → Architecture & Data Flow
- "How are paragraphs / images / lists / anchors rendered out of the box" → Content
- "How do I style / write a custom renderer / mutate the DOM at parse time" → Guides
- "Migrating from v5 / what changed in v6.x" → Migration & Releases
- "End-to-end worked example" → Tutorial
- "API: props, components, hooks signatures" → API Reference
- "How to contribute, run tests, cut a release" → Contributing

## Getting Started

- [Introduction](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/intro): What `@native-html/render` is, when to use it (vs. `react-native-webview`), install, minimal `RenderHtml` example, the published-tree TRT shape, and monorepo package list.
- [Reinvent the Wheel](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/reinvent-the-wheel): A 40-line toy renderer that motivates the real engine by showing what a hand-rolled implementation would look like.
- [FAQ](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/faq): Links, fonts, lists, tables, accessibility, common bugs and workaround props.

## Architecture & Data Flow

- [Architecture](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/architecture): Overview of the three-stage pipeline and the composite rendering architecture (`TRenderEngineProvider` + `RenderHTMLConfigProvider` + `RenderHTMLSource`).
- [Transient Render Engine](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/flow/transient-render-engine): TRT construction, element models (`HTMLElementModel`, content models: textual/block/mixed/none), TNode anatomy and the four types (`TDocument` / `TBlock` / `TPhrasing` / `TText`), translation/hoisting/whitespace-collapsing steps, markers.
- [CSS Processing](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/flow/css-processing): CSS inheritance/specificity rules, mixed style declarations, native vs. web style maps.
- [Rendering](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/flow/rendering): How TNodes are turned into React Native views, internal renderer dispatch, and the rendering lifecycle.

## Content

- [Textual](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/content/textual): Paragraphs, whitespace collapsing (`normal`/`pre`), preformatted blocks, font selection via `systemFonts`/`fallbackFonts`, and the `enableExperimentalBRCollapsing` / `enableExperimentalGhostLinesPrevention` workaround props.
- [Images](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/content/images): Scaling, `object-fit`, automatic sizing via `contentWidth`/`computeEmbeddedMaxWidth`, error/loading states, `useInternalRenderer`, the `IMGElement*` building blocks, `provideEmbeddedHeaders`.
- [Lists](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/content/lists): Supported `list-style-type` values, `customListStyleSpecs`, `@jsamr/counter-style` presets, experimental RTL.
- [Anchors](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/content/anchors): Default `Linking` behavior, mixed content model, relative-URL resolution via `<base>`, `renderersProps.a.onPress`, `useNormalizedUrl`.

## Guides

- [Styling](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/guides/styling): `baseStyle`, `tagsStyles`, `classesStyles`, `idsStyles` (mixed-style declarations, not `StyleSheet`), inline-style processing knobs (`enableCSSInlineProcessing` / `allowedStyles` / `ignoredStyles`).
- [Custom Rendering](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/guides/custom-renderers): Model-based (`customHTMLElementModels`, `HTMLElementModel.fromCustomModel` / `extend`) and component-based (`renderers` prop, `TChildrenRenderer` for children tampering, `useInternalRenderer`, `useRendererProps`).
- [DOM Tampering](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/guides/dom-tampering): `domVisitors` (`onDocument` / `onElement` / `onText`) with `domutils`/`domhandler` examples; `ignoredDomTags` / `ignoreDomNode`; `selectDomRoot`; the explicit-composite prerendering pattern with `useAmbientTRenderEngine`.

## Migration & Releases

- [Migration Guide](https://native-html.github.io/render/docs/migration-guide): v5 → v6 ("Foundry") migration — props to monitor, renamed/moved/discontinued props, and a v5-vs-v6 arguments-equivalence table for custom renderers.
- [Foundry Release Announcement](https://native-html.github.io/render/blog/2021/06/07/foundry-announcement): v6.0 release highlights — TRE, custom renderers, font selection, list renderer, image renderer building blocks, composite architecture, accessibility groundwork.
- [What's New in v6.2?](https://native-html.github.io/render/blog/2021/10/23/6-2-updates): Richer model-based rendering via `getMixedUAStyles` / `reactNativeProps` / `getReactNativeProps`; accessibility for `aria-label`, `role`, `<a>`, `<img>`, `<h1-6>`; `user-select` support.

## Tutorial

- [Blog App Part I](https://native-html.github.io/render/blog/2021/06/27/create-blog-app-rnrh-I): Sets up an Expo + React Navigation + React Native Paper project and an RSS-driven home list.
- [Blog App Part II](https://native-html.github.io/render/blog/2021/06/28/create-blog-app-rnrh-II): Implements an `ArticleScreen` using the explicit composite architecture plus `useAmbientTRenderEngine` to parse the article DOM ahead of render, with a drawer-based table of contents.
- [Blog App Part III](https://native-html.github.io/render/blog/2021/06/29/create-blog-app-rnrh-III): Adds tap-to-scroll via a `Scroller` class shared through React context, custom renderers for `<h1>`/`<h2>`/`<header>`, and styling refinements.

## API Reference

- [API Index](https://native-html.github.io/render/api): Full list of all exported symbols — components, hooks, types, constants.
- [RenderHTML Props](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/renderhtmlprops): All props accepted by the `RenderHTML` component — the primary integration point.
- Key components: [RenderHTML](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/renderhtml), [RenderHTMLSource](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/renderhtmlsource), [RenderHTMLConfigProvider](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/renderhtmlconfigprovider), [TRenderEngineProvider](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/trenderengineprovider), [TDefaultRenderer](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/tdefaultrenderer), [TChildrenRenderer](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/tchildrenrenderer), [IMGElement](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/imgelement).
- Key hooks: [useInternalRenderer](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/useinternalrenderer), [useRendererProps](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/userendererprops), [useAmbientTRenderEngine](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/useambienttrenderengine), [useNormalizedUrl](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/usenormalizedurl), [useContentWidth](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/usecontentwidth).
- Key types: [TNode](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/tnode), [MixedStyleDeclaration](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/mixedstyledeclaration), [HTMLElementModel](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/htmlelementmodel), [CustomRenderer](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/customrenderer), [Markers](https://native-html.github.io/render/api/markers).
